caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bucket with a slightly flared cylindrical shape. The bucket is rendered in shades of blue, with three horizontal yellowish bands (possibly representing metal hoops) evenly spaced around its exterior. The interior of the bucket is colored in a reddish-brown hue, with vertical segments visible, suggesting wooden slats. A gray metal handle is attached to either side of the bucket, and the handle has a wooden grip in the center, colored reddish-brown and shaped with two rounded sections for easier holding. The background is a plain, light beige color with some small brown specks visible across the surface. There is a signature “Geo. V. Vogtles” visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Shaker Bucket
